item.title: ..where we're coming from
item.description: Consider what we mean by identity. It is who we are, ‘where we’re coming from’. As such it is the background against which our tastes and desires and opinions and aspirations make sense. If some of the things I value most are accessible to me only in relation to the person I love, then she becomes part of my own identity. (by Charles Taylor, The Politics of Recognition)
